items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: They took off Perez and I and a guy named Herb Green playing piano, Willie Jones playing drums.

ctx.x: But, yeah, but -- that's sad really. Well, then after -- after the period with Lester you were mostly sort of peaking around New York?

Yeah, well, I worked with Perez in the -- during that time when he -- when the -- when they put him in the all time hall of fame or something. That's the only award that I think that he got. We were broadcasting down at a club there across from the old Cafe Society down there. I can't remember the name of it.

And they got these things out on records. They took off Perez and I and a guy named Herb Green playing piano, Willie Jones playing drums. And that's the last time I worked with Perez. Now, I left Perez then and went with Roy and Cozy and Sal Yaged at the Metropole. I stayed over
